verdict: Yes, for a medical-device team. Ayu Synk pitched digital stethoscopes on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Digital stethoscopes let doctors record and share heart and lung sounds, which helps telemedicine and training.
angle: Doctors, medical colleges and telemedicine providers use digital stethoscopes. Adapters that fit on existing stethoscopes are cheaper than new devices. Sound quality, durability and CDSCO approval are essential.
